model_requirement.self_report: Independent fresh task context; no contact with other agents and no external rule research.

scope: Original Nemesis basic-board standard semi-cooperative core, six original characters. Original English 28-page manual (including illustrations), official FAQ v2.2 base-game Rules/Actions/Rooms/Items, compatible supplemental wording in original publisher-hosted localizations. Optional modes, boards, campaigns and expansions excluded.

authority.governing: Original English 28-page manual, basic-board standard semi-cooperative core and the scoped official FAQ v2.2 entries. FAQ explicit clarifications/exceptions govern the relevant original wording.
authority.supplements: Listed original PL/FR/DE manuals are compatible corroboration only. They do not automatically amend English wording; a clearer glyph can corroborate an English card illustration, but incompatible or stronger localized text cannot supply unannounced English errata.
authority.accepted_Q19_scope: Applied the exact eight required parts and three context-not-automatically-required categories in the clean accepted scope file without re-adjudication.
authority.author_ledger: Read as challengeable source leads/claims, never as proof of coverage or closure. Author zero-addition declarations are not adopted as independent evidence.

method.question_key_read: All 126 actual question objects and all 126 complete expected answers read. Actual stems control requests; volunteered key context does not expand them.
method.primary_read: Read the English core manual text, checked PDF text directly for extraction omissions, and inspected deduplicated native embedded illustrations from all in-scope English pages (including p3 component samples, p7-9 setup/board illustrations, p10 Event, p13 Actions/Items, p14-21 movement/combat/scanning and p22-23 Hands/recipes/Quest/Item examples). Text and native-image extraction were used because a full PDF rendering runtime was unavailable. Read the scoped 61 FAQ entries and cross-checked its original PDF pages2-4. Inspected relevant PL/FR/DE original wording and readable illustrations as supplements, not authority upgrades.
method.novelty_test: A distinct material source-backed procedure/outcome/exception/information boundary beyond closest actual requested/keyed branches; names, costs, quantities and mechanical recombinations alone are insufficient.
method.candidate_search: Whole-bank setup, phase control, movement/exploration/Noise/Doors, Combat/attacks/wounds, contamination, Objects/Items/Quests, every Room and escape/endgame checked; readable illustrations independently challenged. No target count.
method.write_boundary: Only this final JSON and temporary PDF inspection derivatives under /tmp were written.

question_reviews.actual_stem: In a four-player standard game, how many Escape Pods are selected, how are they distributed and oriented, and which tokens start in the Intruder bag?
question_reviews.requested_coverage: Four-player Pod selection, A/B distribution, Locked orientation and starting bag composition.
question_reviews.actual_key: Three random pods; lowest numbered in A, next B, next A, all Locked. Bag: 1 Blank, 4 Larvae, 1 Creeper, 1 Queen, 7 Adults.

question_reviews.actual_stem: How are Objectives filtered and dealt, when does each player choose one, what happens to the rejected card, and do Eggs trigger that choice?
question_reviews.requested_coverage: Objective filtering, secret two-deck deal, first-miniature choice timing, rejected-card secrecy and Egg exclusion.
question_reviews.actual_key: Remove Objectives requiring more players than present; deal one Personal and one Corporate secretly. First Intruder miniature of any type appearing triggers immediate choice by everyone before resolving its Encounter. Remove rejected card face down unseen. Eggs do not trigger it.

question_reviews.actual_stem: You use an Action card with printed cost 2 while holding that card, two other Action cards and two Contamination cards. What is discarded, and can Contamination substitute for payment? What if the card offers OR effects?
question_reviews.requested_coverage: Played card plus two additional Action cards, prohibition on Contamination payment and choosing one OR branch.
question_reviews.actual_key: Discard the played card and two additional Action cards face up. Contamination cannot pay costs. Choose one OR effect.

question_reviews.actual_stem: A Character in a burning Room takes one Action then passes. When do they take Fire damage, can they act again this Player Phase, can they discard cards, and do later players rounds burn them again?
question_reviews.requested_coverage: Fire at own round end, passing restrictions and FAQ Interruption exception, optional hand discards, no later-round Fire after passing.
question_reviews.actual_key: At end of own round take 1 Light Wound. Passing bars normal Actions this Player Phase, but official FAQ permits Interruption after passing. May discard any number of hand cards on passing. No further Fire wounds from later players rounds this turn.

question_reviews.actual_stem: Describe entering an empty unexplored Room: tile, Item Counter, Exploration effect, Noise roll and token destination. How do Silence, Danger and an already occupied destination alter the Noise roll?
question_reviews.requested_coverage: Reveal Room/token, Item Counter and exceptions, Exploration resolution/removal, empty versus occupied entry Noise and automatic Silence/Danger.
question_reviews.actual_key: Reveal Room and Exploration token; set counter to token number except Nest/Slime Room; resolve effect and remove Exploration token from game. Roll Noise in empty Room unless Silence or Danger exploration cancels it. Occupied Room (Character or Intruder) gives no movement Noise roll.

question_reviews.actual_stem: What does Careful Movement cost and replace, when is it forbidden, and can a Closed Door be crossed or a miniature stop in a Corridor?
question_reviews.requested_coverage: Careful Movement cost and replacement, all-noisy and Combat prohibitions, Closed Door movement barrier and no stopping in Corridors.
question_reviews.actual_key: Cost 2 Action cards; replaces post-movement Noise roll with placing Noise in a chosen connected Corridor. Forbidden in Combat or when all destination Corridors have Noise. Closed Doors block player movement; no miniature stops in Corridors.

question_reviews.actual_stem: You roll a number for a Corridor already holding Noise, with a Technical Corridors Entrance in your Room. Give the Encounter sequence, Noise removal, token destination and Surprise Attack comparison; do Contamination cards count?
question_reviews.requested_coverage: Encounter sequence, all adjacent Noise including Technical Corridors, token set aside, triggerer's entire hand and strict fewer-than Surprise comparison.
question_reviews.actual_key: Resolve Encounter: remove all connected Noise including Technical Corridors; draw bag token; place matching Intruder; compare token number to all cards in triggering hand including Contamination. Fewer cards causes Surprise Attack against triggerer, equal or more does not. Set token aside.

question_reviews.actual_stem: How does Danger resolve with several eligible neighboring Intruders, and when none are eligible? Does moving an Intruder into your Room count as an Encounter? How does Slime affect Silence?
question_reviews.requested_coverage: All eligible neighboring Intruders, fallback Noise only in unmarked Corridors, movement versus Encounter, Slime converting Silence.
question_reviews.actual_key: Move all neighboring Intruders not in Combat into current Room. If none eligible, put Noise in each connected Corridor lacking it including Technical Corridors. Moving Intruder into occupied Room is Combat, not Encounter. Slime converts Silence Noise/exploration results to Danger.

question_reviews.actual_stem: During an Encounter you draw Blank. What happens to Noise and the Blank; when is an Adult added? Contrast Blank in bag development.
question_reviews.requested_coverage: Encounter Blank restores adjacent Noise and returns; last-token-only Adult addition versus routine development addition, subject to available Adult.
question_reviews.actual_key: Encounter replaces connected Noise in every Corridor; return Blank; add Adult only if Blank was last token in bag and a spare Adult is available; no miniature or Surprise Attack. Development always attempts adding one available Adult then returns Blank.

question_reviews.actual_stem: Two Intruders attempt to move together from the same Room through one Closed Door. Where do they end, what happens to the Door, can it later close, and would a Noise-triggered appearance be blocked by that Door?
question_reviews.requested_coverage: Simultaneous Intruder Closed Door destruction with all staying, Destroyed state and Plasma Torch exception, appearance independent of Door.
question_reviews.actual_key: Both stay in original Room and destroy Door simultaneously. Destroyed Door permits movement but cannot close except Plasma Torch. Noise-triggered appearance ignores Closed Door.

question_reviews.actual_stem: An injured Intruder moves into Technical Corridors with Noise already there. What happens to its miniature, injuries, token and Noise? Can Characters or Doors normally use those Corridors?
question_reviews.requested_coverage: Duct removal, injuries discarded, corresponding token returned, Noise retained, normal Character access exceptions and no Doors.
question_reviews.actual_key: Remove miniature, discard injuries, return matching token to bag; keep Noise. Characters barred except Mechanic Technical Corridors card and Technical Corridor Plans Item; Doors never placed there.

question_reviews.actual_stem: Describe an ordinary Shoot versus Melee Action: card/ammo costs, target location, Contamination, a miss, and the two-hit die result.
question_reviews.requested_coverage: Ordinary Shoot/Melee costs, same-Room target, Weapon/Ammo, Contamination destination/timing, miss and two-hit outcomes.
question_reviews.actual_key: Both cost 1 Action card against target in same Room. Shoot needs Weapon in Hand and spends 1 Ammo; normal two-hit deals 2 injuries subject to Weapon. Melee draws Contamination to Action discard before choosing target, miss causes Serious Wound, two-hit deals only 1 injury.

question_reviews.actual_stem: After damage, how are Larva, Adult and Queen death checked, when is a Carcass placed, and what if a Queen check draws a Retreat arrow?
question_reviews.requested_coverage: Larva one-Injury death, Adult one-card and Queen two-card endurance checks, Carcass placement, Queen Retreat priority/direction.
question_reviews.actual_key: Larva dies at 1 injury without Carcass. Adult draws one Attack card blood, dies if blood <= current injuries and leaves Carcass. Queen draws two, sums blood and compares same way; any Retreat arrow causes retreat via Event-card corridor number, discard Event, rather than normal numerical resolution. Any killed non-Larva Intruder, including Queen, leaves a Carcass in its death Room; Larva does not.

question_reviews.actual_stem: A Character Escapes a Room with two Intruders toward an empty unexplored Room. When do attacks occur, who is targeted, what happens if they die, and what follows if they survive?
question_reviews.requested_coverage: Ordinary Escape cost/destination, each Intruder attacks escaper before movement, corpse origin on death, ordinary entry after survival.
question_reviews.actual_key: Pay Movement cost 1, choose neighboring Room. Before moving resolve separate Attack from each Intruder targeting escaper. Death leaves Corpse in starting Room; survival completes move and standard exploration/Noise.

question_reviews.actual_stem: In an ordinary Intruder Attack with several Characters, how is the target chosen and ties broken; how is a hit determined; what changes for Larva and where does its Contamination go?
question_reviews.requested_coverage: Ordinary attack target by fewest Action cards with turn-order tie, matching symbols, blood ignored, discard, Larva infestation/Contamination destination.
question_reviews.actual_key: Fewest Action cards in hand; tie First Player or next in turn order. Matching attacker symbol on drawn Attack card means resolve effect; otherwise miss; ignore blood and discard card. Larva draws no Attack card: place miniature on target Character board and give Contamination on top of Action discard.
scope_or_limit_notes: Detailed English p20 explicitly says fewest Action cards; p28 shorthand says fewest cards. Prefer the detailed procedure for this keyed branch and record the internal shorthand inconsistency; do not silently count Contamination by analogy with Surprise.

question_reviews.actual_stem: At three Serious Wounds, does dressing one prevent death from a Light Wound? What happens at a third Light Wound otherwise, what does Heal remove, and where do a dead Characters Corpse and Heavy Objects go?
question_reviews.requested_coverage: Three-Serious death including dressed Wounds, Light conversion, meaning of Heal, corpse and dropped Heavy Objects.
question_reviews.actual_key: No: dressed still counts; any further Wound kills at three Serious. Third Light clears Light track and causes Serious Wound. Heal removes specified Light Wound or discards dressed Serious card. Place Corpse and drop Heavy Objects in death Room.

question_reviews.actual_stem: Contrast Canteen/Shower scanning with Surgery: which cards are scanned and removed, how is a Larva handled, and what costs or turn consequences follow Surgery?
question_reviews.requested_coverage: Hand-only Canteen/Shower scans versus Surgery all three zones, opposite removal sets, Larva handling, Surgery Light Wound/pass/whole-hand shuffle.
question_reviews.actual_key: Canteen/Shower optionally scan hand Contamination, remove non-Infected; infected gives Larva and retains card, existing Larva means death/Creeper. Canteen heals 1 Light; Shower removes Slime. Surgery scans deck/hand/discard, removes infected and Larva, then 1 Light Wound, automatic pass, shuffle all cards including hand into deck; empty hand until next turn.
scope_or_limit_notes: The Canteen healing/Shower Slime clauses in the key are correct extra context; they do not expand the actual scanning/Surgery request into Q126's explicit additive-versus-OR question. Ordinary two-card Room cost is supplied by the common Room rule; the specifically requested post-Surgery costs are Light Wound, pass and empty hand.

question_reviews.actual_stem: How can uncarried Eggs be destroyed with Shoot/Melee, grenades, Molotov and Fire; which Melee penalties are waived, when is Noise rolled and when is the Nest destroyed?
question_reviews.requested_coverage: Uncarried Egg destruction by damage and specified throws/Fire, conditional Melee miss waiver, Noise after attempts, zero-Egg Nest destruction.
question_reviews.actual_key: Each Injury from Shoot/Melee destroys 1 uncarried Egg. Successful Egg Melee retains the ordinary draw of 1 Contamination card onto the Action discard pile. On a missed Egg Melee, no Contamination card and no Wound are suffered. The sources do not specify how the normal pre-roll draw and miss waiver are reconciled; no refund or delayed draw is invented. Grenade destroys 2 Eggs, Molotov 1; Noise after every destruction attempt including miss. Fire destroys 1 uncarried Egg each Fire Damage step. Nest destroyed once all its Eggs taken/destroyed; mark Injury in Nest.
scope_or_limit_notes: Key preserves English successful-Melee Contamination and conditional miss waiver, and explicitly does not invent a refund/delayed draw. Operational reconciliation remains a source gap, not an answer to be guessed.

question_reviews.actual_stem: What permits or prevents entering an Escape Pod, what must you resolve first, how many Characters and Heavy Objects fit, and what are the options and consequences when you wait?
question_reviews.requested_coverage: All eight fixed accepted parts: entry, pre-boarding Noise, capacity, immediate waiting pass/Noise exposure, timed later choices, second boarder, Intruder return and later Malfunction.
question_reviews.actual_key: Use the corresponding Evacuation Section A/B Room Action in that Room, paying 2 Action cards. The Pod must be Unlocked with a free Character space; an Intruder or Malfunction in the Section prevents entry. Resolve Noise first; an Intruder appearing or reaching the Section makes boarding fail. Each Pod has two Character spaces; Heavy Objects use none. After boarding one may launch immediately or choose to wait. Waiting passes the current turn and the Character is treated as present in the Section for bag-development Noise rolls. At the start of the Character’s first round in each later Player Phase choose wait/pass, launch, or exit free into the corresponding Section Room and play a full two-Action round. If an Intruder appears in the Section, immediately return every Character in any Pod of that Section to its Room. A new boarder may immediately launch both occupants. A later Malfunction does not remove an already-boarded Character’s normal wait/launch/exit choices; it only blocks new entry.
scope_or_limit_notes: Applied the accepted clean scope unchanged. All eight required parts are present in the supplied key. Immediate-launch/full launch resolution/unlock triggers are not retroactively made required by this row.

question_reviews.actual_stem: Give the endgame checks in order. What happens with two Damaged Engines, a non-Earth destination (including Quarantine/Mars), and an infected survivor or one carrying a Larva? Do pod passengers need Contamination checks?
question_reviews.requested_coverage: Ordered Engines/Coordinates/Contamination/Objectives checks; Damaged-Engine destruction, non-Earth/Mars exception, infected/Larva shuffle-draw and Pod inclusion.
question_reviews.actual_key: Engines then Coordinates then Contamination then Objectives. If ship survives to checks: two/three Damaged explodes kills all aboard incl Intruders; non-Earth kills sleepers but ship/Intruders survive, Quarantine sleeper survives Mars. All survivors including launched pod passengers scan all Contamination; any infected triggers shuffle all Action/Contamination draw 4, any Contamination kills else survives. Larva skips scanning and directly does shuffle/draw. Survivors then reveal/check chosen Objective.

question_reviews.actual_stem: How are the basic and additional Room tiles and Exploration tokens placed at setup; what Coordinates, Destination, Time, Engines, Eggs and Weaknesses start on the board?
question_reviews.requested_coverage: Basic/additional tiles and Exploration setup, hidden Coordinates, Destination B, Time green, paired Engines, five Eggs and three hidden Weaknesses.
question_reviews.actual_key: All 11 basic tiles face down in 1 slots; five random additional tiles face down in 2 slots, leftovers boxed unseen; random face-down Exploration per tile. Random face-down Coordinates, Destination B, Time green. Each numbered Engine has shuffled Damaged/Working pair face down, top true status. Five Eggs, three random face-down Weaknesses.

question_reviews.actual_stem: How are Player Numbers assigned and Characters drafted; what does each Character receive and where do Characters and the initial Corpse begin? Are Quest Items usable immediately?
question_reviews.requested_coverage: Player Number/Inventory assignment, Character draft, board/miniature/deck/loaded Weapon/inactive Quests, initial Hibernatorium/Corpse and First Player.
question_reviews.actual_key: Random Help cards 1 through player count with matching Inventories assign Player Numbers; in number order draw two draft cards, reveal, choose one, shuffle other back. Receive board, ringed miniature in Hibernatorium, shuffled 10 Action cards, starting Weapon in Hand fully loaded, two horizontal inactive Quest Items; activate by printed quest then ordinary Items. Player 1 First Player; blue Corpse in Hibernatorium is Character Corpse Object.

question_reviews.actual_stem: When are Action hands refilled and the First Player token passed; what happens when the Action deck empties, and what are the normal discard destinations and visibility?
question_reviews.requested_coverage: Start-of-phase draw-to-five and token pass except first turn, empty Action deck reshuffle, normal face-up discard destinations and Search exception.
question_reviews.actual_key: At Player Phase start draw to 5, shuffle Action discard whenever required draw finds empty deck; then pass token left except first turn. Actions/Contamination to own Action discard, Items/Event/Attack/Serious Wounds to respective discard piles face up; markers to pools. Search example has explicit face-down return exception.

question_reviews.actual_stem: Give the Event Phase order, which Intruders move on an Event card, what controls movement and when the event effect resolves; what happens when Event and Intruder Attack decks run out?
question_reviews.requested_coverage: Event Phase order, symbol-based unoccupied-Room Intruder movement and direction/ducts, movement-before-effect, Event/Attack deck exhaustion reshuffles.
question_reviews.actual_key: Time and active Self-Destruct advance, Intruders in Combat attack, Fire Damage, Event card movement then effect, bag development fully resolved before next turn. Move symbol-matching Intruders without Characters in Room via card-number Corridor; ducts remove miniature/return token. Discard Event unless instructed otherwise. Empty Event/Attack decks reshuffle their respective discard piles.
scope_or_limit_notes: Current request does not ask the individual illustrated Coolant Leak deck-reconstitution instruction. Generic resolve-card wording and the key's unless-instructed-otherwise caveat do not supply the missing specific branch; see finding F1.

question_reviews.actual_stem: In bag development, describe Larva, Creeper, Adult, Breeder and both Queen branches. Which tokens are removed or returned, who rolls Noise and when does the next turn begin?
question_reviews.requested_coverage: All named bag-development branches, removed/returned tokens, ordered Noise excluding Combat, Queen/Nest branches, Adult immediate return and completed effects before next turn.
question_reviews.actual_key: Larva removed to token pool, add Adult; Creeper removed to pool, add Breeder. Adult/Breeder cause ordered Noise rolls excluding Combat; token returns. For Adult specifically, return token immediately BEFORE Noise so same token may be redrawn in an Encounter. Queen: Characters in Nest means Queen there and Encounter; otherwise including undiscovered Nest add Egg; return Queen. Fully resolve triggered effects before new turn.
scope_or_limit_notes: Adult pre-Noise return is explicit FAQ correction. Do not silently extend its timing answer to Breeder beyond the source wording or invent exceptional Queen multi-Character targeting/supply resolution.

question_reviews.actual_stem: When do Fire and Malfunction exhaustion end the game; what if the target Room already has that marker, and where do removed markers go? What happens to sleepers and Intruders when hull integrity is lost?
question_reviews.requested_coverage: Fire/Malfunction finite pools, required new placement exhaustion, existing marker no-op, one-per-Room and pool returns; all aboard die on destruction.
question_reviews.actual_key: Eight of each; required new placement with no pool marker explodes/loses hull integrity, all aboard including sleepers/Intruders die. Existing same marker means nothing happens; max one per Room. Removed markers return to pools.

question_reviews.actual_stem: What does a Malfunction disable and leave usable, where can it never be placed, and does it change an Engine token or harm an already-hibernating Character?
question_reviews.requested_coverage: Malfunction disables Room Action/Computer but not Search, forbidden Rooms, Special Rooms, independent Engine status and protected existing sleepers.
question_reviews.actual_key: Disables Room Action and Computer; Search still works. Never in Nest or Room Covered In Slime. Special Rooms can malfunction; Engine Working/Damaged unaffected and already-hibernating Characters unaffected. Repair cards/Tools can remove marker.

question_reviews.actual_stem: Which Items may be hidden, what do other players see, what is the Inventory limit, and what must happen on use? How are Heavy Items/Objects, added Items and Duct Tape handled?
question_reviews.requested_coverage: Hidden unlimited normal inventory and visible backs, reveal on use, public Heavy Hands and overflow, added Items and Duct Tape versus Objects.
question_reviews.actual_key: Normal Items hidden in unlimited Inventory, others see backs/colors; used Item shown. Heavy Items/Objects public in two Hands, third requires dropping one. Added Items act as one with base card. Duct Tape combines two Heavy Items into one Hand, never Objects.

question_reviews.actual_stem: What happens to an Item versus an Object voluntarily dropped, when and at what Action cost may you drop, and how do found Weapons differ from starting Weapons in Ammo?
question_reviews.requested_coverage: Free own-turn dropping, Object remains versus discarded Item, searched one Ammo versus fully loaded starting Weapon and capacity.
question_reviews.actual_key: Drop freely during own turn no Action; Objects stay in Room, Items discarded/lost. Found Weapon has 1 Ammo versus starting fully loaded, neither exceeds capacity.

question_reviews.actual_stem: How does Search choose its deck, draw and keep cards, return the rejected card, change the Item Counter, and handle zero Items, Special Rooms and Blue Items?
question_reviews.requested_coverage: Room-color deck including white one-deck choice, draw two/keep one/bottom other, Item Counter/zero, Special Rooms and Crafted-only Blue.
question_reviews.actual_key: Search Action: choose one matching Red/Yellow/Green deck, white may choose any ONE, draw two, keep one, put rejected card at BOTTOM of same deck, not shuffle. Lower counter one, zero prevents Search except e.g. Scavenging; Special Rooms cannot Search. Blue Items only Craft.

question_reviews.actual_stem: How does Craft pay its Action and components, must the result be available, can you inspect the deck, and what Crafted Items exist?
question_reviews.requested_coverage: One-card Craft Action plus two matching components, availability, selecting rather than random draw, inspectable deck and four products.
question_reviews.actual_key: Cost one Action card plus discard two Items with blue component icons matching two grey result icons, choose/take available card not random draw; unavailable cannot build. May inspect deck any time. Antidote, Taser, Flamethrower, Molotov Cocktail.

question_reviews.actual_stem: Who pays for a Trade and who may join; can you give something for nothing, exchange Ammo, or need a separate Pick Up Action for a searched Heavy Item?
question_reviews.requested_coverage: Initiator cost, all same-Room participants including non-initiator-only exchanges, consensual gifts, no Ammo exchange, pickup applies to Objects not searched Heavy Items.
question_reviews.actual_key: Initiator pays one Action card; Characters in same Room may agree to exchange Items/Objects including gifts. Cannot exchange Ammo. Pick Up Heavy Object cost one applies Corpses/Carcasses/Eggs, not searched Heavy Items. All Characters in the Room may trade with each other, including an exchange solely between two Characters who did not pay for the Action.

question_reviews.actual_stem: How do you reveal Weaknesses: what Object corresponds to each card, where must it be, is it consumed, who benefits and must you personally research for a Discover Weakness Objective?
question_reviews.requested_coverage: Object-to-slot Weakness matching, Object actually in Laboratory, research/reveal/nonconsumption, shared benefit and nonpersonal research Objective.
question_reviews.actual_key: Character Corpse, Intruder Egg, Intruder Carcass correspond to three face-down slots. Research matching Object present in Laboratory, carried or uncarried, reveal and leave card on board, Object not consumed. Discovered rules benefit all; anyone can do research for Objective.

question_reviews.actual_stem: What are the common prerequisites and cost for Room Actions, what does a Computer icon itself do, and how does Fire affect Room Actions or Searching?
question_reviews.requested_coverage: Ordinary Room Action two-card cost, location/explicit exceptions, no Combat/Malfunction, Computer reference significance, Fire does not bar use or Search.
question_reviews.actual_key: Cost two Action cards, Character in matching Room unless explicit special ability, no Combat or Malfunction. Computer icon only significant when another rule references it, unavailable under Malfunction. Fire alone bars neither Room Action nor Search.

question_reviews.actual_stem: What exactly does the Armory recharge, by how much, and what limits apply?
question_reviews.requested_coverage: Armory two Ammo to one Energy Weapon, no Classic reload and capacity bound.
question_reviews.actual_key: Add two Ammo to one Energy Weapon, never Classic Weapons, never above printed capacity.

question_reviews.actual_stem: What are the three mutually exclusive Emergency Room treatments; does dressing remove the Wound or merely its effect, and do identical Serious Wound effects stack?
question_reviews.requested_coverage: Emergency Room three exclusive treatments, dressing suppresses effect without reducing count and identical effects do not stack.
question_reviews.actual_key: Dress all Serious OR heal one dressed Serious OR heal all Light. Dress flips/ignores effect but retains Serious count; identical Serious effects do not stack.

question_reviews.actual_stem: What does sending a Signal actually do and what is its game use; can Comms be absent from a normal game?
question_reviews.requested_coverage: Personal Signal marker, Objective use only and Comms always included as basic Room.
question_reviews.actual_key: Comms Room Action puts Status marker on own Signal space, used for Objectives only. Basic Room so always aboard.

question_reviews.actual_stem: How does Fire Control affect a chosen Room and its Intruders if the Room has Fire, or has none?
question_reviews.requested_coverage: Any selected Room, remove Fire if present and all Intruders flee with separate random direction cards, usable with no Fire.
question_reviews.actual_key: Choose any one Room, remove Fire if present; all its Intruders flee random directions, one Event card drawn per Intruder. Works with no Fire.

question_reviews.actual_stem: Describe starting, stopping and restarting Self-Destruct, advancing it, the yellow threshold, its final space, a jump while active and a Character already hibernating.
question_reviews.requested_coverage: Self-Destruct start/stop/restart/advance, first-yellow irreversibility and Pod unlock, no repeated unlock, final/jump destruction, sleeper initiation restriction and Event exception.
question_reviews.actual_key: Start marker first green; advance with Time. Stop removes it, restart green. First yellow irreversible/unlocks all Pods, which can relock; subsequent yellow spaces do NOT re-unlock them. Skull or jump with active sequence destroys ship. Characters cannot initiate sequence with anyone hibernating, but Coolant Leak Event can start it despite sleepers.

question_reviews.actual_stem: Which Room can Airlock Control target, what Door condition is required, what happens immediately, and what cancels or completes the procedure and when?
question_reviews.requested_coverage: Other Yellow Room and no Destroyed connected Door, closing/marker, opening cancellation and all-closed end-of-Player-Phase death/Fire removal.
question_reviews.actual_key: Any other Yellow Room with no Destroyed Doors in connected Corridors; close every connected Door, mark procedure. Opening any before Player Phase end removes token/cancels. All closed after all players pass kills all Characters/Intruders immediately, remove token and Fire.

question_reviews.actual_stem: When does Cabins increase a hand and to what size; what disables it and is it a paid Room Action?
question_reviews.requested_coverage: Cabins passive start-of-turn draw-to-six, no Intruders and no Malfunction, no paid Room Action.
question_reviews.actual_key: Passive at start of new turn draws to six instead of five if Character there and no Intruders; Malfunction disables. No paid Action.

question_reviews.actual_stem: Can Command Center select a distant Room and individually open some Doors and close others, including a Destroyed Door?
question_reviews.requested_coverage: Command Center any Room and independently chosen Door states, Destroyed Door exception only Plasma Torch.
question_reviews.actual_key: Choose any one Room and individually open/close any connected Doors, need not all same. Destroyed Door cannot close except Plasma Torch.

question_reviews.actual_stem: What can Engine Control Room check or change and how do Malfunctions in an Engine Room affect that check?
question_reviews.requested_coverage: All three Engine statuses from Engine Control despite target Engine Room Malfunction; no status change there.
question_reviews.actual_key: Check status of all three Engines even if corresponding Engine Room malfunctions; cannot change status from Control Room.

question_reviews.actual_stem: What does Hatch Control System change and how does Monitoring Room inspect a location: explored or unexplored, what components, secrecy and replacement?
question_reviews.requested_coverage: Hatch one Pod flip, Monitoring one unexplored Room plus token, secrecy, return and permitted lying.
question_reviews.actual_key: Hatch flips one Pod Locked/Unlocked. Monitoring secretly looks at one unexplored Room tile and its Exploration token, replaces both, may lie.

question_reviews.actual_stem: Does entering Room Covered With Slime require an Action to acquire Slime, can it have an Item Counter or Malfunction, can Slime stack, and does showering extinguish Fire?
question_reviews.requested_coverage: Automatic entry Slime, no counter/Malfunction, no stacking, Shower/Clothes removal and Shower not extinguishing Fire; first-entry Silence interaction.
question_reviews.actual_key: Entry automatically gives Slime; no paid Action. No Item Counter, never Malfunction. Max one Slime, extra does nothing; Clothes/Shower remove. Shower does not remove Fire and Fire allowed there. On first entering the Room Covered With Slime, acquire Slime before resolving its Exploration token. Thus a Silence Exploration effect becomes Danger on that first entry, subject to the already-covered Careful Movement/Reconnaissance cancellation.
scope_or_limit_notes: Automatic entry Slime is used when resolving the resulting Silence token. Careful Movement/Reconnaissance cancellation still applies; no Malfunction marker allowed and no Search under p25 PDF note.

question_reviews.actual_stem: In Cockpit what can you learn or change, who sees the information, what does Destination refer to and which restrictions apply after someone hibernates or an Intruder is present?
question_reviews.requested_coverage: Cockpit secret Coordinates lookup/return, destination marker among four card entries, no setting in Combat/after hibernation and common restrictions.
question_reviews.actual_key: Check Coordinates secretly and replace, may lie and should remember; Set Destination moves marker to chosen track space referring to one of four card destinations. No Set with Intruder in Cockpit; no change after any hibernation; common Room prerequisites apply.

question_reviews.actual_stem: How does Engine checking differ from repairing/breaking; what can stay secret, what must be announced and do you need a prior check or functioning Engine Room?
question_reviews.requested_coverage: Secret top Engine check versus two-token repair/break, may lie about status, must disclose order change, no prior check and repair despite Malfunction.
question_reviews.actual_key: Check secretly top token only may lie. Repairs Action or Tools permits take both tokens secretly restack any order. Need announce whether order changed, not whether repaired. Works without prior check and despite Malfunction. Top true status, two Working needed.

question_reviews.actual_stem: When is hibernation legal, what roll and failure condition apply, what leaves play on success, and which later ship actions are forbidden? Does later Malfunction wake sleepers?
question_reviews.requested_coverage: Open blue Time prerequisite, functioning/unoccupied Hibernatorium and cost, Noise/failure, miniature/participation removed, later destination/Self-Destruct restrictions and Malfunction immunity.
question_reviews.actual_key: Only Time on blue, functioning Hibernatorium without Intruder; Room Action cost two, Noise roll, appearing Intruder fails. Success remove Character miniature and participation until end checks. Destination change and starting Self-Destruct prohibited. Later Malfunction has no effect on sleepers.

question_reviews.actual_stem: What ends the game when Time runs out or the last active Character leaves/dies/hibernates; how is an active Self-Destruct resolved and do Intruders die from a normal jump?
question_reviews.requested_coverage: Final-red immediate jump and awake death, last active Character termination, active Self-Destruct destruction versus ordinary jump, Intruders survive ordinary jump.
question_reviews.actual_key: Time final red immediate jump, awake aboard die; Intruders unharmed. Last alive non-hibernating aboard leaves/dies/hibernates: advance active Self-Destruct to final red and destroy ship, else advance Time final red and jump. Then survival/victory checks if survivors.

question_reviews.actual_stem: Can a Character directly attack another, and may an Action still harm other crew indirectly? Give source-supported examples.
question_reviews.requested_coverage: No direct attacks on Characters; intentional/accidental indirect harm and supported examples.
question_reviews.actual_key: Never directly attack Characters; indirect harm permitted, e.g. grenade at Intruder with crew present, trap in burning Room, Self-Destruct.

question_reviews.actual_stem: You must place an Adult but all eight models are on board. What explicit procedure applies, and what if an Intruder enters an unexplored Room by movement?
question_reviews.requested_coverage: All-eight Adult placement procedure only frees non-Combat Adults, returns matching tokens if possible; moved Intruders stay in unexplored Rooms without revealing them.
question_reviews.actual_key: Remove ALL Adults not in Combat and return corresponding tokens to bag if possible, then place Adult in Encounter Room. Moving Intruder into unexplored Room does not reveal Room/token and is not removed. If all eight are in Combat, the source supplies no executable resolution for freeing a model; do not invent one.
scope_or_limit_notes: The key correctly declines to invent a model-freeing resolution when all eight Adults are in Combat.

question_reviews.actual_stem: For shooting, describe the target-size restrictions of the small curled and larger curved Intruder die symbols; what happens on those same symbols in Melee against an ineligible target?
question_reviews.requested_coverage: Small/larger Intruder-symbol target eligibility in Shoot and Melee, with Serious Wound on Melee ineligible miss.
question_reviews.actual_key: Small curled symbol hits Larva/Creeper for one only; larger curved hits Larva/Creeper/Adult for one only; other targets missed. Same target restrictions in Melee; miss causes Serious Wound.

question_reviews.actual_stem: At the final Contamination check, a survivor has no Larva and every Contamination card scans non-Infected. Must they perform the four-card draw or remove those cards, and does an earlier launched Pod escape the Objective check?
question_reviews.requested_coverage: No final four-card draw without Infected/Larva, no final-scan non-Infected removal instruction and Pod passengers still need Objective/survival checks.
question_reviews.actual_key: No four-card draw unless infected found or Larva on board; end scan does not instruct removing non-infected. Pod passenger still needs surviving Contamination check and chosen Objective fulfillment.
scope_or_limit_notes: Final scan has its own process; general midgame scan/Larva consequences must not be imported into this final check.

question_reviews.actual_stem: Which two component symbols are required for each Crafted Item: Antidote, Taser, Flamethrower and Molotov Cocktail? Describe the symbols rather than guessing Item-card names.
question_reviews.requested_coverage: Four exact two-icon component recipes from the readable character-board/crafting illustrations.
question_reviews.actual_key: Antidote: flame and medical cross. Taser: battery/lightning and screwdriver/tool. Flamethrower: flame and screwdriver/tool. Molotov Cocktail: flame and folded cloth/fabric. Each takes two matching blue-component Item cards.

question_reviews.actual_stem: What defines being in Combat, how do In Combat Only and Out of Combat Only restrictions work, and may an unmarked Action or Item be used in either situation? Do Eggs cause Combat?
question_reviews.requested_coverage: Same-Room Intruder defines Combat, Eggs excluded, restriction icons and unmarked Actions, limited Basic Actions and no Room/Quest activation.
question_reviews.actual_key: Sharing Room with Intruder defines Combat, not Eggs. In Combat Only requires it, Out of Combat Only requires none. Unmarked card/Item actions can be used in either subject to requirements; Basic Actions in Combat are limited to Shoot, Melee and Basic Movement as Escape. No Room Actions or Quest activation in Combat.

question_reviews.actual_stem: For an Objective that Player X cannot survive, must you personally kill them, does hibernating or escaping count as death, and how does only survivor differ? What must your own Character do regardless?
question_reviews.requested_coverage: Named-player death rather than personal kill, no death credit for surviving hibernation/escape, only-survivor meaning and own survival.
question_reviews.actual_key: X must be dead at game end; need not be killed by own Actions; hibernating or escaping alive is not death. Only survivor means nobody else survives. Own Character must survive by launched Pod or successful hibernation, plus meet Objective.

question_reviews.actual_stem: If a Door token must be placed and none are in the pool, what happens? How are Open, Closed and Destroyed Doors represented, and may two Door tokens share one Corridor or be placed in Technical Corridors?
question_reviews.requested_coverage: Door shortage relocation, Open/Closed/Destroyed representation, maximum one per Corridor and no Technical Corridor Door.
question_reviews.actual_key: Take any Door token elsewhere on board and move to required Corridor. Open no token, Closed standing, Destroyed lying. Max one per Corridor; none in Technical Corridors.

question_reviews.actual_stem: The first Character dies while the ship's Pods are Locked. What happens to every Pod immediately, and can they subsequently be Locked again?
question_reviews.requested_coverage: First Character death unlocks every Pod; later ordinary relocking remains possible.
question_reviews.actual_key: All Escape Pods immediately become Unlocked. They may subsequently be Locked and Unlocked normally, for example through Hatch Control System.

question_reviews.actual_stem: What does the Storage Room's Search for an Item Room Action let you draw and keep, where exactly does the rejected card go, and what are the common Room Action cost and restrictions?
question_reviews.requested_coverage: Storage two-card draw from chosen regular color, keep one/bottom one and common cost/location/Combat/Malfunction restrictions.
question_reviews.actual_key: Pay two Action cards while in the functioning Storage Room and out of Combat. Choose the Red, Yellow or Green Item deck, draw two cards, keep one, and put the other at the bottom of that deck.

question_reviews.actual_stem: While in the Nest, how do you take an Egg still represented on the Intruder board, what does that Action cost, and what happens immediately afterward? How does this differ from picking up a previously dropped Egg token in your Room?
question_reviews.requested_coverage: Nest two-card Room Action takes board Egg then Noise and uses Hand, versus one-card Basic pickup of previously dropped Egg without instructed Noise.
question_reviews.actual_key: Use the Nest's Take one Egg Room Action, costing two Action cards and subject to common Room Action restrictions. Take one Egg token from the Intruder board, then perform a Noise roll. The Egg is a Heavy Object and occupies a Hand slot. Picking up an already dropped Egg is the ordinary one-card Pick Up Heavy Object Basic Action; that pickup procedure does not itself instruct a Noise roll.

question_reviews.actual_stem: You perform the Action printed on a One Use Only Item. Besides paying its Action-card cost and showing it, what happens to the Item card after use?
question_reviews.requested_coverage: One Use Only Item goes to proper Item discard after effect, in addition to Action-card payment/showing.
question_reviews.actual_key: Discard the Item card to the appropriate Item discard pile after using it. This is in addition to discarding the Action cards needed to pay its Action cost.

question_reviews.actual_stem: For a rule concerned with the Character's arrival on Earth, where is a Character in a launched Escape Pod treated as having arrived? Does this establish that the ship itself reached Earth?
question_reviews.requested_coverage: Launched Pod Character treated as arriving Earth, without determining ship destination or exempting final checks.
question_reviews.actual_key: Any Character in a launched Escape Pod is always treated as having arrived on Earth. This is the Character's status and does not establish that the ship reached Earth; the ship's destination and survival are checked separately. The passenger still undergoes the normal endgame Contamination and Objective checks.

question_reviews.actual_stem: While waiting in an Escape Pod, must you roll Noise when Adult bag development calls for it?
question_reviews.requested_coverage: Waiting Pod Character treated as in Section for Adult-development Noise.
question_reviews.actual_key: Yes. Waiting Character is treated as present in the corresponding Room and rolls Noise.

question_reviews.actual_stem: A Malfunction is placed in the Evacuation Section while you are already waiting in its Pod. Can you launch, wait or exit, and what does that Malfunction prevent?
question_reviews.requested_coverage: Later Section Malfunction leaves existing boarder's launch/wait/exit choices, blocks new entry only.
question_reviews.actual_key: May still launch, wait or exit; Malfunction only prevents using Room Action to ENTER Pods.

question_reviews.actual_stem: When Escaping from several differently sized Intruders, how many attacks and in what order?
question_reviews.requested_coverage: Each escaping Intruder attacks, larger-first sequence explicitly listed Queen/Breeder/Adult/Larva by FAQ.
question_reviews.actual_key: One Attack per Intruder, starting with larger ones: Queen, Breeder, Adult, Larva (decreasing size).
scope_or_limit_notes: FAQ Rules 5 explicitly lists Queen, Breeder, Adult, Larva and omits Creeper. The listed sequence is supported; a complete relative Creeper ordering is not supplied and must not be fabricated.

question_reviews.actual_stem: An Event instructs removing itself from the game but its other effect cannot be resolved. Is it removed?
question_reviews.requested_coverage: Remove-from-game Event still removed when another part cannot resolve.
question_reviews.actual_key: Yes, remove it even if its other content cannot resolve.

question_reviews.actual_stem: When Adult bag development triggers Noise, when does the drawn Adult token return, and may a triggered Encounter draw that very token?
question_reviews.requested_coverage: Adult token returned before development Noise and can be redrawn immediately.
question_reviews.actual_key: Return immediately BEFORE Noise rolls; yes it may be drawn again during an Encounter.

question_reviews.actual_stem: A retreating Intruder meets a Closed Door. What happens normally, and what changes under The Way of Moving Weakness for an affected non-Breeder/non-Queen?
question_reviews.requested_coverage: Retreat at Closed Door normally destroys Door/stays; The Way of Moving exception for affected non-Breeder/non-Queen.
question_reviews.actual_key: Normally destroys Door and stays in Room; with that Weakness for an affected Intruder other than Breeder/Queen nothing happens at all.

question_reviews.actual_stem: Does the Hand Serious Wound increase the cost of Basic Shoot, and why?
question_reviews.requested_coverage: Hand wound does not increase Basic Shoot cost; Shoot is not Item Action.
question_reviews.actual_key: No. Shoot is a Basic Action, not an Item Action.

question_reviews.actual_stem: With Vulnerability to Fire discovered, how much extra Injury applies per damage instance, and how many Injuries for a Flamethrower double-crosshair hit?
question_reviews.requested_coverage: Vulnerability to Fire adds once per damage instance, Flamethrower two-crosshair total three.
question_reviews.actual_key: One extra per damage instance, x+1; this hit causes 3 Injuries, not one bonus per separate Injury.

question_reviews.actual_stem: A Larva attacks a Character who already has a Larva on their board. What happens to each Larva and to the Character?
question_reviews.requested_coverage: Second attacking Larva disappears, resident Larva stays, new Contamination but no instant death from that attack.
question_reviews.actual_key: Attacking Larva disappears; existing board Larva stays; Character gets one Contamination card, no automatic death from this attack alone.

question_reviews.actual_stem: After a Character hibernates, Fire appears in the Hibernatorium. Does the sleeper take Fire wounds and what can still kill them?
question_reviews.requested_coverage: Later Hibernatorium Fire does not wound out-of-play sleeper; ship destruction and end checks still matter.
question_reviews.actual_key: No Fire wounds; treated out of play. Ship destruction can still kill sleeper; endgame survival checks remain applicable.

question_reviews.actual_stem: Can the Coolant Leak Event start Self-Destruct while someone hibernates, and how does that differ from starting it as a Character?
question_reviews.requested_coverage: Coolant Leak can initiate despite sleepers, contrasting Character initiation restriction.
question_reviews.actual_key: Yes, Event can; Character initiation is prohibited while anyone hibernates.

question_reviews.actual_stem: Where do discarded/dead Intruder tokens go, and can they be reused later?
question_reviews.requested_coverage: Discarded/dead Intruder tokens remain reusable supply, including bag additions and matching ducts.
question_reviews.actual_key: Unused token pool, not removed from game; may be reused for bag additions or a matching Intruder entering ducts.

question_reviews.actual_stem: Can Fire and Malfunction markers be placed in unexplored Rooms?
question_reviews.requested_coverage: Fire may be placed in unexplored Rooms; Malfunction may not.
question_reviews.actual_key: Fire yes; Malfunction no.

question_reviews.actual_stem: A Character with two Light Wounds receives two more Light Wounds. What Wounds remain after resolving them?
question_reviews.requested_coverage: Two Light plus two more resolves to one Serious and one Light.
question_reviews.actual_key: One Serious Wound from third Light plus one Light Wound remaining from fourth.

question_reviews.actual_stem: On a Character death in standard play, what happens to Heavy Objects versus their Item cards?
question_reviews.requested_coverage: Standard-play death drops Heavy Objects and makes Item cards disappear.
question_reviews.actual_key: Heavy Objects (Corpse/Carcass/Egg) drop in Room; Items disappear from game rather than becoming dropped Objects. Cooperative item retention excluded.
scope_or_limit_notes: Uses standard-play FAQ Rules 24, not the excluded cooperative Rules 17 item-retention exception.

question_reviews.actual_stem: Self-Destruct reaches its first yellow space, Pods unlock, then are relocked. Does reaching the next yellow space unlock them again?
question_reviews.requested_coverage: Only first yellow automatically unlocks, not later yellow after relocking.
question_reviews.actual_key: No; later yellow spaces do not re-unlock. Unlock manually.

question_reviews.actual_stem: Does destroying the ship fulfill Objectives to kill the Queen or destroy the Nest; does that alone make your Character a winner?
question_reviews.requested_coverage: Ship destruction meets Queen/Nest destruction requirements but own survival/other Objective requirements remain.
question_reviews.actual_key: Yes fulfills those destruction/kill requirements; Character must still survive and satisfy all own Objective requirements.

question_reviews.actual_stem: May you intentionally spend an empty Trade Action with no intention of exchange; what if honest negotiations end without a trade?
question_reviews.requested_coverage: Deliberately empty state-unchanging Trade prohibited, honest unsuccessful negotiation allowed.
question_reviews.actual_key: Empty Actions that do not meaningfully change game state should be disallowed, including deliberately empty Trade. Honest negotiations may result in no Items traded.

question_reviews.actual_stem: What kind of Action activates a Quest Item, may it be done in Combat, and does a Room Malfunction prevent it?
question_reviews.requested_coverage: Quest activation is printed Basic Action, Out of Combat Only and possible despite Malfunction.
question_reviews.actual_key: Basic Action printed on quest card, forbidden in Combat; Room Malfunction does not prevent activation.

question_reviews.actual_stem: Which Basic Actions can be used in Combat; can you Trade, Craft or Pick Up an Object there? What about permitted card or Item Actions?
question_reviews.requested_coverage: Combat Basic Actions limited to Shoot/Melee/Basic Movement Escape, no Trade/Craft/pickup/Room/Quest; unrestricted card/Item Actions may remain legal.
question_reviews.actual_key: Only Basic Shoot, Melee, or Basic Movement as Escape. No Trade/Craft/PickUp, no Room Action or Quest activation. Card/Item actions without Out of Combat restriction may be used subject to own requirements.

question_reviews.actual_stem: Can Soldier use Covering Fire only on themselves, and how are direction, Noise and Surprise targeting handled when moving two Characters?
question_reviews.requested_coverage: Covering Fire can move Soldier alone, separate chosen directions, one Noise roll and Soldier Surprise comparison.
question_reviews.actual_key: May use for self alone. Both move in direction of their choice, perform one Noise roll; if Encounter, Surprise Attack check is for Soldier.

question_reviews.actual_stem: How does Full Auto calculate damage and consume Ammo?
question_reviews.requested_coverage: Full Auto discards all Ammo then single Shoot, adds half discarded Ammo rounded down plus Assault Rifle bonus.
question_reviews.actual_key: Remove all Ammo, then one Shoot Action. Add Shoot Injuries plus discarded Ammo divided by two rounded down, plus 1 for Assault Rifle bonus.

question_reviews.actual_stem: When can Nerves of Steel be chosen relative to seeing the Attack card, and may it protect you when another Character triggered a Surprise Attack?
question_reviews.requested_coverage: Nerves of Steel may follow Attack-card inspection and may protect Soldier on another's Surprise, without protecting other Characters.
question_reviews.actual_key: May see Attack card before using it. May use when someone else triggers Surprise but only Soldier benefits; e.g. Frenzy still affects others.

question_reviews.actual_stem: Careful Movement or Reconnaissance reveals a Danger/Silence Exploration token. Does that automatic result apply or the movement ability?
question_reviews.requested_coverage: Careful Movement and Reconnaissance cancel automatic Danger/Silence Exploration as well as Noise roll.
question_reviews.actual_key: Careful Movement result applies instead; cancels Noise roll and automatic Danger/Silence Exploration results. Reconnaissance also cancels both.

question_reviews.actual_stem: May Captain use Order while personally in Combat; may Intercom force someone else to Move out of Combat and what rules apply?
question_reviews.requested_coverage: Captain Order barred while Captain in Combat; remote Intercom Order can make another Escape normally.
question_reviews.actual_key: Captain cannot use Order while in Combat. Through Intercom can force another Character to Move out of Combat with normal Escape rule.

question_reviews.actual_stem: Who can draw an Action card when Captain uses Motivation with active Intercom?
question_reviews.requested_coverage: Motivation via Intercom affects computer-Room Characters and those sharing Captain's Room.
question_reviews.actual_key: All Characters in Rooms with a Computer and all Characters in Captain Room.

question_reviews.actual_stem: Moving via Technical Corridors card or Plans Item reveals a Door Exploration token. Where does the Door go?
question_reviews.requested_coverage: Technical Corridors movement ignores Door Exploration effect because entry direction undefined.
question_reviews.actual_key: Ignore Door token effect because entry direction cannot be determined.

question_reviews.actual_stem: Can you Interrupt a Captain Order played remotely via Intercom when you are not in the Captain Room; does passing bar playing Interruption?
question_reviews.requested_coverage: Remote Order cannot be Interrupted without sharing Captain's Room; passing does not bar Interruption.
question_reviews.actual_key: No remote Interruption: must share Room with Character performing Action. Passing does not bar playing Interruption.

question_reviews.actual_stem: After two Actions your hand is empty. Do you automatically pass then, and what timing consequence can Fire or Bleeding have?
question_reviews.requested_coverage: Empty hand after two Actions does not immediately pass; next-round passing can cause further Fire/Bleeding.
question_reviews.actual_key: No automatic pass. Wait for next round to pass; can suffer Fire/Bleeding again because passing ends another round.

question_reviews.actual_stem: Rest scans several Infected cards while no Larva was on your board. Can the scan kill you from multiple infected cards; when can Rest be fatal?
question_reviews.requested_coverage: Rest multiple Infected cards gives one Larva; only prior Larva permits that scan's fatal outcome.
question_reviews.actual_key: No; place one Larva regardless number infected. Can be fatal only if a Larva already was on board before Rest.

question_reviews.actual_stem: You throw a Grenade/Molotov at uncarried Eggs in the Nest from a neighboring Room. Where is the required Noise roll resolved?
question_reviews.requested_coverage: Noise from neighboring-Room Egg throw resolved in throwing Character's current Room.
question_reviews.actual_key: In the Character current Room, not the Nest.

question_reviews.actual_stem: Scientist uses Intranet to research an Object while carrying it outside the Laboratory. Can that reveal a Weakness?
question_reviews.requested_coverage: Remote Intranet research still requires Object itself in Laboratory.
question_reviews.actual_key: No; Object itself must be in Laboratory, even when remote action used.

question_reviews.actual_stem: Storage Item Counter is zero. Can you use its Room Action repeatedly, and how is ordinary Search different?
question_reviews.requested_coverage: Storage Room Action repeatable at counter zero; counter constrains ordinary Search card Action.
question_reviews.actual_key: Yes Room Action usable repeatedly paying cost, subject to normal restrictions. Counter only limits Search Action card; at zero normal Search cannot be used.

question_reviews.actual_stem: When the Nest is on Fire and Vulnerability to Fire is discovered, how many of its Eggs are destroyed each Fire Damage step?
question_reviews.requested_coverage: Nest Fire with Vulnerability to Fire destroys two board Eggs per Fire step.
question_reviews.actual_key: Two Eggs instead of normal one.

question_reviews.actual_stem: Take an Egg from the Intruder board and drop it back in the Nest Room. Does it restore the Nest Egg total for destruction purposes?
question_reviews.requested_coverage: Dropped Egg in Nest remains Heavy Object without restoring Nest board-Egg hit points.
question_reviews.actual_key: No; dropped Egg is a normal Heavy Object in Room and no longer counts toward Nest hit points.

question_reviews.actual_stem: Smoke Grenade says each target loses one Action card. Who chooses and where does it go?
question_reviews.requested_coverage: Smoke Grenade affected player chooses an Action card from hand and discards it.
question_reviews.actual_key: Each targeted player chooses one Action card from hand and discards it.

question_reviews.actual_stem: Can Medkit and Bandages be used on other Characters?
question_reviews.requested_coverage: Medkit and Bandages can be used on other Characters.
question_reviews.actual_key: Yes, both.

question_reviews.actual_stem: May you use your Energy Charge directly to reload another Character Weapon; what procedure permits that recharge?
question_reviews.requested_coverage: Cannot directly use own Energy Charge on another's Weapon; Trade Charge, owner uses in own round.
question_reviews.actual_key: No; Trade Charge to that Character, who uses it during own round.

question_reviews.actual_stem: Alcohol scans an Infected Contamination card. Does this place a Larva and what happens instead?
question_reviews.requested_coverage: Alcohol Infected scan draws new Contamination without placing Larva.
question_reviews.actual_key: No Larva from this result; take a new Contamination card.

question_reviews.actual_stem: Adding Extended Magazine or Auto Loader to an already-used or empty Energy Weapon: does it immediately provide extra Ammo?
question_reviews.requested_coverage: Extended Magazine/Auto Loader immediately give extra Ammo on used/empty Energy Weapon.
question_reviews.actual_key: Yes.

question_reviews.actual_stem: When you Craft a Flamethrower, does it start fully loaded or with the one Ammo of a searched Weapon?
question_reviews.requested_coverage: Crafted Flamethrower starts fully loaded, not searched-Weapon one Ammo.
question_reviews.actual_key: Fully loaded.

question_reviews.actual_stem: Does the Hand Serious Wound affect Scout Motion Scanner and why?
question_reviews.requested_coverage: Scout Motion Scanner unique reaction unaffected by Hand Item-Action wound.
question_reviews.actual_key: No; unique reaction ability, not Item Action.

question_reviews.actual_stem: Describe Antidote: scan scope, removed cards, new Contamination, reshuffling, hand retention and passing; how does Surgery differ?
question_reviews.requested_coverage: Antidote all-zone scan/removal, Larva removal, new Contamination, non-Infected preservation, retained hand and pass, versus Surgery whole-hand shuffle/no new card.
question_reviews.actual_key: Scan all Contamination from hand/deck/discard, remove all Infected from game, take one new Contamination, reshuffle it with all non-Infected scanned Contamination and Action cards except cards left in hand, then pass. May retain hand cards. Surgery instead shuffles entire hand too and does not gain extra Contamination (and its own wound/removal procedure still applies). Antidote also removes a Larva already on the Character board.
scope_or_limit_notes: FAQ Items 9 governs reshuffle/hand retention; readable p23 Antidote illustration additionally supports removal of an already-present Larva. Does not import generic infected-scan death into this removal procedure.

question_reviews.actual_stem: On exploration, where are Slime, Fire, Malfunction and Door effects placed, and which Corridor receives the Door?
question_reviews.requested_coverage: Exploration Slime on board, Fire/Malfunction in entered Room, Door in entry Corridor; token removed after once-only effect.
question_reviews.actual_key: Slime on Character board, Fire/Malfunction in explored Room, Door in Corridor used to enter. Resolve each token once then remove from game; general placement exceptions apply.

question_reviews.actual_stem: During the Event Phase Fire Damage step, how many Injuries does each Intruder in a burning Room take, when relative to attacks, and does it trigger an Injury Effect check?
question_reviews.requested_coverage: Event Fire Damage after attacks gives each Intruder one Injury and normal Injury Effect/death/retreat check.
question_reviews.actual_key: Each takes one Injury after Intruder Attack step; place injury and resolve ordinary Injury Effect, including possible death/retreat.

question_reviews.actual_stem: Can you perform any Search Action in the Nest or Room Covered With Slime, even though ordinary Room tiles usually permit searching?
question_reviews.requested_coverage: Explicit prohibition on any Search Action in Nest and Room Covered With Slime, present in PDF despite extraction omission.
question_reviews.actual_key: No Search Action in either Nest or Room Covered With Slime; the original PDF explicitly prohibits it.
scope_or_limit_notes: Both no-Search notes verified directly in the English PDF p25 text; the supplied extraction omits these sentences.

question_reviews.actual_stem: An Intruder is in a neighboring Room, but the connecting Corridor has a Closed Door. May you throw a Grenade into that Room through that Corridor?
question_reviews.requested_coverage: Closed Door blocks Grenade throwing through that Corridor.
question_reviews.actual_key: No. A Closed Door also blocks Grenade throwing through its Corridor; it is not merely an obstacle to miniature movement.

question_reviews.actual_stem: A Noise marker was placed on the basic board's Technical Corridors space because of a roll in one Room. Later, a Character in a distant Room rolls the number of a different Technical Corridors Entrance: is that entrance already noisy? Also, can a Closed Door make an ordinary Corridor's Noise marker apply only on the other side of that Door?
question_reviews.requested_coverage: Technical Corridor Noise is one board-wide network marker and ordinary Corridor Noise spans Closed Door.
question_reviews.actual_key: The single Technical Corridors marker counts at every Technical Corridors Entrance on the whole basic board, so the later numbered result triggers an Encounter rather than placing a second marker. An ordinary Corridor Noise marker affects the whole Corridor, including both sides of a Closed Door.

question_reviews.actual_stem: Outside Combat, what can a single use of Bandages do to Wounds, and what two alternatives does Clothes offer? Can Bandages heal an undressed Serious Wound directly? Give each Item's Action-card cost and whether its alternatives can be combined in one use.
question_reviews.requested_coverage: Bandages and Clothes complete exclusive menus, undressed Serious cannot be directly healed, costs/icons/one-use.
question_reviews.actual_key: Bandages costs 1 Action card and either dresses 1 Serious Wound OR heals all Light Wounds. It does not directly heal/discard an undressed Serious Wound. Clothes costs 1 Action card and either discards a Slime marker OR dresses 1 Serious Wound. Choose one effect per Item use; both are Out of Combat Only and One Use Only, so discard the used Item.

question_reviews.actual_stem: What can the Fire Extinguisher Item do in one use: which Room or Intruder may it affect, can it both extinguish Fire and force Retreat, and what does it cost?
question_reviews.requested_coverage: Fire Extinguisher local Fire removal OR one local Intruder Retreat, not both, one-card cost and consumption.
question_reviews.actual_key: Spend 1 Action card and discard the One Use Only Fire Extinguisher. Choose either to discard the Fire marker from your current Room OR choose 1 Intruder in your current Room and force it to Retreat. The two effects are alternatives, not a combined Fire Control System procedure.

question_reviews.actual_stem: What are the Taser Item's two alternative effects and their legal target location? If you choose its Character-targeting effect, is just one Action card lost, or what exactly is discarded?
question_reviews.requested_coverage: Taser local Intruder Injury plus Retreat OR chosen local Character's entire hand discard; cost/consumption.
question_reviews.actual_key: Choose 1 Intruder in your Room: it suffers 1 Injury and Retreats. OR choose 1 Character in your Room: that Character must discard all cards from their hand. It is the whole hand, not just one Action card. Taser costs 1 Action card and is One Use Only.

question_reviews.actual_stem: With no Weakness modifying damage, you shoot a Queen using a Flamethrower. What happens on a small curled Intruder-symbol result, on the blank miss face, and on the two-crosshair face? Include any Fire placement.
question_reviews.requested_coverage: Flamethrower minimum damage except blank, otherwise-size-ineligible Queen receives one; ordinary double Injury plus Fire placement.
question_reviews.actual_key: The small curled symbol still deals 1 Injury: Flamethrower always deals at least 1 Injury except on the blank miss face. A blank misses. The two-crosshair result deals the normal 2 Injuries and also places a Fire marker in the Room you are in. General marker-placement exceptions still apply.
scope_or_limit_notes: English minimum damage/blank exception and Fire clause checked in illustration; compatible FR/DE illustration helps identify the obscured two-crosshair glyph without replacing English authority.

question_reviews.actual_stem: What Room may a Molotov Cocktail target, and what does it do immediately to Fire, Intruders and Characters there? If you use it in your own Room, does its immediate damage exclude you?
question_reviews.requested_coverage: Molotov current/neighboring Intruder Room, immediate Fire and Injury/Serious Wound to every being including user, independent of later Fire.
question_reviews.actual_key: Choose 1 Room with an Intruder: your Room or a neighboring Room. Place a Fire marker there. All beings in that Room suffer 1 Injury/Serious Wound: each Intruder suffers 1 Injury and each Character suffers 1 Serious Wound, including you if you are there. This is immediate, separate from later Fire damage. It costs 1 Action card and is One Use Only. The Nest rule separately permits a Room of uncarried Eggs to be treated as an Intruder target.

question_reviews.actual_stem: When you use your own Energy Charge, how much Ammo may it restore and to what type of Weapon? What alternative Door effect can you choose, and which Doors are in range?
question_reviews.requested_coverage: Energy Charge full own Energy Weapon reload OR connected one Door, no Combat restriction, cost/consumption and Destroyed Door limit.
question_reviews.actual_key: Either fully load one of your own Energy Weapons (up to its capacity), OR Open or Close 1 Door in a Corridor connected to your current Room. The Door alternative does not also reload a Weapon. The Item has no Combat restriction icon, so it may be used in or out of Combat subject to its own requirements. It costs 1 Action card and is One Use Only. The ordinary prohibition on closing Destroyed Doors still applies; Energy Charge is not the Plasma Torch exception.
scope_or_limit_notes: Complete p23 Energy Charge illustration lacks either Combat-restriction icon. It has the component symbol, which is not a restriction icon.

question_reviews.actual_stem: Where and at what Action-card cost do you activate the Pilot's Evacuation Key? Once active, where must you be to use it, what can it do to Pods, and is it a reusable remote substitute for Hatch Control System?
question_reviews.requested_coverage: Evacuation Key printed activation in Fire Control System, active use local to Section and one Pod, cost/out-of-Combat/one-use and no reusable remote use.
question_reviews.actual_key: Activate it in the Fire Control System Room as the printed cost-1 Basic activation action (Out of Combat Only; a Room Malfunction does not bar Quest activation). The active Key is used in an Evacuation Section Room to Lock or Unlock 1 of the Escape Pods in that Section. Its use costs 1 Action card, is Out of Combat Only and One Use Only. It is local to that Evacuation Section and is discarded on use.

question_reviews.actual_stem: Where and at what cost is the Captain's Log Key activated, and how is the activated Item used to inspect another player's secret Objectives? Must that other Character share your Room?
question_reviews.requested_coverage: Log Key activation in Comms; use from functioning Computer to inspect chosen player's retained Objectives without shared-Room target requirement; cost/icons/disposal.
question_reviews.actual_key: Activate it in the Comms Room with the printed cost-1 Basic activation action, out of Combat. The active Log Key costs 1 Action card, is One Use Only and Out of Combat Only; use it in a Room with an available Computer to look at the Objective cards of a chosen player. The chosen player's Character need not share your Room: the card restricts the user's location, not the target's location. A Malfunction makes a Room's Computer unavailable, although it does not prevent the Quest activation itself.
scope_or_limit_notes: Target-location restriction is not present on active Log Key. This does not authorize inspecting removed rejected Objectives forbidden by p12/Q02.

question_reviews.actual_stem: What does the Six Shooter card require for reloading, and how many Injuries does its single-crosshair Combat die result deal when no Weakness changes damage?
question_reviews.requested_coverage: Six Shooter only reloads with Reload card and adds one Injury on single crosshair.
question_reviews.actual_key: It can only be reloaded with the Reload Action card. Its single-crosshair result deals 1 additional Injury, for 2 Injuries total instead of the ordinary 1.

question_reviews.actual_stem: The Captain plays Suppressive Fire, whose printed Action cost is 0. Must any Ammo still be spent? Does it move both the Captain and another Character, or one selected Character; must that other Character agree, and are the normal Escape attacks resolved?
question_reviews.requested_coverage: Suppression costs zero additional Action cards but spends Ammo/played card, selects self OR willing other, waives Escape attacks.
question_reviews.actual_key: Discard 1 Ammo as the card instructs. Move either yourself OR 1 other chosen Character in your Room, with that Character's agreement. It does not move both. This movement does not trigger an Intruder Attack. The printed 0 does not waive the separate Ammo requirement; the played Action card itself is still discarded under the ordinary card-play rule.

question_reviews.actual_stem: When you use Nemesis Plans, how many unexplored Room tiles may you check, may you also inspect their Exploration tokens as with Monitoring Room, and what are the Item's Action-card cost and use restrictions?
question_reviews.requested_coverage: Nemesis Plans checks two Room tiles but excludes Exploration tokens, unlike Monitoring; cost/icons/disposal.
question_reviews.actual_key: Check any 2 unexplored Room tiles, but do not look at their Exploration tokens. Pay 1 Action card; the Item is One Use Only and Out of Combat Only, so discard it after use. Monitoring Room instead checks 1 unexplored Room tile together with its Exploration token.

question_reviews.actual_stem: With no Weakness modifying damage, you Shoot an Intruder using the Scientist's Pistol and roll the two-crosshair result. How many Injuries do you place, and do you still check the Injury Effect?
question_reviews.requested_coverage: Scientist Pistol two-crosshair overridden to one Injury, with normal subsequent Injury Effect check.
question_reviews.actual_key: Only 1 Injury, because the Scientist's Pistol treats a two-hit roll as one hit. Then resolve the ordinary Injury Effect check for the Intruder. The example on printed page 19 places one Injury on an Adult and draws one Attack card for the blood comparison.

question_reviews.actual_stem: After every player has had one round of two Actions, does the Event Phase begin automatically? Describe who takes the next round, the order and size of rounds while players remain active, what happens when a player takes only one Action or none, and exactly when the Player Phase ends.
question_reviews.requested_coverage: Repeated clockwise two-Action active rounds from First Player until all pass; one/no Action requires pass and passed players skipped except Interruption.
question_reviews.actual_key: Starting with the First Player, proceed clockwise, each active player taking a round of 2 Actions. After everyone has had a round, repeat rounds in that order while at least one player has not passed. Taking only 1 Action requires passing; taking none or being unable to act requires passing. Players who have passed are skipped for ordinary later Actions in this Player Phase; the FAQ permits Interruption after passing. Begin the Event Phase only after all players have passed.

question_reviews.actual_stem: When you use Canteen or Shower, what non-scanning benefit does each Room give? Must you choose between that benefit and scanning Contamination, or can one Room Action give both? May you take the non-scanning benefit without choosing to scan?
question_reviews.requested_coverage: Canteen healing/Shower Slime removal plus independently optional additional hand scan for one Room Action, not an OR replacement.
question_reviews.actual_key: Canteen heals 1 Light Wound. Shower discards your Slime marker if you have one. Each additionally permits you to choose to scan all Contamination cards in your hand and remove all non-Infected cards; that scan is optional and additional to the Room benefit, not an OR replacement. You may take the non-scanning benefit without scanning. If you do scan, resolve the infected/Larva consequences as normal. Pay the ordinary single Room Action cost, subject to common Room restrictions.

question_reviews.actual_stem: Before a Contamination card has been Scanned, is its INFECTED/not-INFECTED status known to its player? When an effect instructs a Scan, how is that status read, and does a coded word merely resembling INFECTED count?
question_reviews.requested_coverage: Hidden infection before Scan, red foil/exact INFECTED word and lookalike warning; effect-specific scan consequences, no free scan permission.
question_reviews.actual_key: The infection status is hidden by the patterned field and remains unknown until the card is Scanned (including the endgame scan). Place the Scanner's red foil over the coded field. If the exact word INFECTED appears in one of the text lines, the card is Infected; if it does not, it is not Infected. Similar-looking coded words do not suffice. Resolve the additional effect specified by the particular scanning Action/Room/Item; this question does not grant a free Scan or override those procedures.
